rule: In a free-for-all (no teams) Commander match of several games, when the previous game had a winner and more than one losing player, the player who lost first in that game is 'the loser of the previous game' for 103.1 and chooses who takes the first turn; if several players lost at that same earliest moment, the winner of that game picks which of those players chooses. If the previous game was a draw, rule 103.1's draw sentence applies unchanged.
